t_err_evidence: Step 3: The agent writes optimize.py with 'np.save("solution.npy", result.x)' — the wrong output path and binary format instead of the required /app/solution.txt text file. This is the first decisive mistake establishing the wrong artifact contract.
t_commit_evidence: Step 7: The agent rewrites the solver into optimize_improved.py but again saves to 'solution.npy' rather than /app/solution.txt, confirming the agent will not produce the required deliverable regardless of subsequent actions.
t_surface_evidence: Step 13: The 'ls -la' output lists solution.npy and solution_summary.txt but shows no solution.txt, making the missing required deliverable directly observable.
trigger_explanation: The agent never verified what file name and format the task specification required for the output artifact. It defaulted to 'solution.npy' (numpy binary) throughout all solver iterations, never checking whether the tests expected '/app/solution.txt' in text format.
